source.author: verg
source.text: Respice res bello varias; miserere parentis longaevi, quem nunc maestum patria Ardea longe dividit.
source.text_original: Respice res bello varias; miserere parentis / longaevi, quem nunc maestum patria Ardea longe / dividit.'
source.text_english: Look upon the changing fortunes of war; pity your aged father, whom now his native Ardea, in sorrow, keeps far apart from you.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sin aliud Fortuna parat, miserere parentum, Mors bona, dum metus est nec adhuc dolor.
reuse.text_original: sin aliud Fortuna parat, miserere parentum, / Mors bona, dum metus est nec adhuc dolor.
reuse.text_english: But if Fortune is preparing something else, have pity on my parents, gentle Death, while there is still fear and not yet pain.
